title: 13 Best Herbal Tinctures For Eye Pain
intro: Herbal tinctures for Eye pain are liquid extracts made from plants, which are used to treat and relieve discomfort in the eyes caused by various factors such as dryness, strain, or irritation. The benefits of using herbal tinctures for eye pain include their natural and non-invasive approach, which makes them an excellent alternative to conventional treatments. Additionally, herbal tinctures such as chamomile, lavender, and peppermint can also be used to treat eye pain due to their calming and anti-inflammatory properties that can help relax and reduce tension in the eyes.
